notes_for_editor: Status is the main open question: FFLOS Wisconsin list says Gone (and cites NHLR US 1242), while the NHLR entry registered in 2017 describes a standing 84-ft tower with a photo credit to Brian Ziegler. Next check: Wisconsin DNR, Washburn County or a recent photo. The 1977 Five Mile Tower Fire shares the lookout's name; no source read connects the fire to the tower, so the story mentions only the shared name. Not used: a Wisconsin Historical Society Facebook post (login wall, not readable) and a search snippet about a 1932 Aermotor tower moved by the CCC in 1935; it is unclear whether either refers to this tower. Access and staffing not found in the sources read; no photo URLs added.
